seed_rule: SeedSequence([seed_root, part_id, case_index, arm_index, regime_index, replica, stream]).generate_state(1, uint64); part_id=0 for Part A (regime_index=0) and part_id=1 for Part B; stream 0 acquisition shots, stream 1 terminal/look bootstrap, stream 2 independent replanning pilot (ritz_si_* arms only). Development seed 501 is strictly excluded from evaluation.
development: Seed 501 calibrated shot schedules, bank anchors, and infinite-shot noisy biases across beh2_8q, lih_8q, h4_8q, and lih_10q_stretched before locking this declaration. Key pre-registration calibrations from seed 501: (1) on well-conditioned 8q banks, rank confirms at look 1 so SE-driven stops occur near SE ~ 1.1-1.5 mHa (Gaussian 1-sigma tail implies ~15-25% of unbiased stops naturally exceed 1.6 mHa while ~95% lie within 3.2 mHa); (2) on beh2_8q and lih_8q, si_qwc beat bank-weighted si_fc while two-stage ritz_si_fc cut shots 3x below si_fc even after billing its 20k pilot; (3) under depol2q_p010_r3, 10% relative-bias gating (max 3 CZ) still admits 12-16 mHa absolute bias on ~150 mHa correlation energies, whereas 5% gating (max 1 CZ) cuts bias 5.2-12.7x, and unmitigated 2% readout error in sc_card_full induces 62-125 mHa bias even on QWC. No seed-501 row enters evaluation.
schedule_rule: Matched total physical-shot schedule across arms: pilot_shots_per_group = max(2, cumulative_total_shots[0] // n_settings); each subsequent round budget is max(n_settings, cumulative_total_shots[k] - cumulative_spent_so_far). For ritz_si_* arms, replan_pilot_total_shots are drawn first from an independent stream on the same-k bank-weighted si plan, billed unconditionally to total_shots, and subtracted from cumulative_total_shots before building the fresh acquisition schedule on the replanned settings.

P1a_weighted_vs_unweighted.scope: Part A across beh2_8q, lih_8q, h4_8q at matched block sizes k in {1, 2, 8}
P1a_weighted_vs_unweighted.rule: For each (case, k) pair, weighted sorted insertion achieves <= 0.80 * median total physical shots of unweighted largest_degree (or strictly lower mean shots when medians tie on the discrete look grid), with >= 30/32 target_met stops, zero reduced-rank stops, and 95% schedule-adjusted bootstrap-spread coverage not rejected by one-sided exact binomial test (Bonferroni alpha = 0.05 / 9).
P1a_weighted_vs_unweighted.interpretation: Confirmatory check on declared 8q banks; shot ratio 95% bootstrap CI reported alongside medians.

P1b_ritz_replan_vs_bank_fc.scope: Part A across beh2_8q, lih_8q, h4_8q comparing ritz_si_fc (including billed replanning pilot) vs si_fc and si_qwc
P1b_ritz_replan_vs_bank_fc.rule: Report paired shot ratio (total physical shots of ritz_si_fc / si_fc), RMSE, 95% coverage, and empirical R vs state-independent R_hat. Explicitly test whether ritz_si_fc lowers median/mean total physical shots below si_fc after billing its pilot; report honestly if si_qwc matches or beats FC on state-dependent variance.
P1b_ritz_replan_vs_bank_fc.interpretation: Predeclared comparative endpoint without forcing FC to beat QWC.

P2_stretched_rank_transfer.scope: Part A on lih_10q_stretched (16 outer replicas)
P2_stretched_rank_transfer.rule: si_k2 and ritz_si_k2 each achieve >= 12/16 true precision stops (target_met and |error| <= 1.6 mHa), <= 1/16 false precision stops, and zero reduced-rank stops, matching the RANK_AWARE_STOP feasibility bar while reporting realized shot savings against ldf_qwc and si_qwc.

P3_galic_noise_gate.scope: Part B on beh2_8q, lih_8q, h4_8q under depol2q_p002_r3 and depol2q_p010_r3 (2Q-isolated) plus sc_card_full (diagnostic)
P3_galic_noise_gate.rule: Under both 2Q-isolated regimes, si_fc_galic_tight achieves strictly lower exact infinite-shot bias |E_noisy_inf - E_exact| and lower finite-shot RMSE than si_fc_unconstrained on all three molecules, and strictly fewer false precision stops (target_met with |error| > 1.6 mHa) whenever unconstrained FC has |bias| > 1.6 mHa. Under sc_card_full, explicitly report readout-dominated bias across all arms including QWC without claiming grouping mitigates readout flips.

secondary_endpoints: All-attempt target_met, within_1sigma (<=1.6 mHa), within_2sigma (<=3.2 mHa), false_precision_stops, exhaustions, failures, reduced_rank_stops
State-independent R_hat, terminal empirical covariance-aware R from GroupedWordCache, and calibration ratio R / R_hat
Logical CZ total/max, routed 2Q gates, illustrative device_seconds, classical planning/solve/bootstrap wall time, peak RSS
Exact infinite-shot noisy bias, finite-shot bias, RMSE, and MSE = bias^2 + variance decomposition (Part B)
Unconditional and stop-conditional 68% and 95% coverage and median widths for delta and schedule-adjusted bootstrap-spread intervals
failure_policy: All attempts, physical shots (including replanning pilots), and measured/bootstrap solves are counted unconditionally. Exhaustions and numerical failures never count as true precision stops and count as uncovered in unconditional coverage. Atomic checkpoints preserve every completed row; unexpected errors abort without selective retries.
limitations: Small 8-qubit three-direction molecular banks and one 10-qubit engineered near-cutoff stretched bank; raw Ritz sampled_precision estimator without exact-oracle-certified control variates; ideal statevector and gate-level depolarizing/readout simulation rather than calibrated quantum hardware. Fixed-bank exact projected energies are the estimands, not full-CI chemical accuracy. Rank-margin and terminal bootstrap intervals are heuristic, not finite-sample or anytime-valid certificates.
